column1: A WSI of Normal at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of well-organized follicles and paracortical regions, intact capsule, clear medullary sinuses, and a homogeneous or slightly variegated pink/purple background.

A WSI of Tumor at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of irregularly shaped tumor regions replacing or disrupting normal lymph node architecture, often appearing as solid, distinct masses with pale or basophilic coloration, and possible extracapsular extension.

A WSI of Normal at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of lymphocytes (small, round, dark nuclei) and histiocytes in the sinuses, clearly defined germinal centers with tingible body macrophages, and endothelial cells lining the sinuses, showing low nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio.

A WSI of Tumor at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of large pleomorphic cells, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, atypical nuclei with irregular contours and coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli, mitotic figures, and formation of glandular or solid structures that contrast sharply with surrounding lymphocytes.
